# frame reference position

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:frameReferencePosition`](gmeow-frameReferencePosition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/frameReferencePosition>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reference position of a temporal frame, when one is needed. Optional: TAI needs none; civil time needs a timezone.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md) -> [`gmeow:ReferencePosition`](../classes/gmeow-ReferencePosition.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:frameReferencePosition`](gmeow-frameReferencePosition.md) from [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md) to [`gmeow:ReferencePosition`](../classes/gmeow-ReferencePosition.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md), [`gmeow:ReferencePosition`](../classes/gmeow-ReferencePosition.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to wire a frame to the place its time depends on — a timezone for civil offset, an observatory for sidereal time, a planet for an off-Earth calendar.

### Avoid when

- Avoid on position-independent frames (TAI, TT, zero-offset UTC) and avoid asserting two positions (functional — at most one per frame).

### How to use

- Set at most one [`gmeow:ReferencePosition`](../classes/gmeow-ReferencePosition.md) individual; leave it absent where the scale alone fixes the time, since the property is optional.

### Examples

- ex:myFrame [`gmeow:frameReferencePosition`](gmeow-frameReferencePosition.md) ex:torontoTZ.
